chunks: I bring to you the messages of my Lord, and give you sincere advice, for I know from God what you do not know.
ai.seo_question: What are the three main roles of the Prophet mentioned in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-A'raf is often cited to affirm the Prophet's (and by extension, the Imams') possession of 'Ilm al-Ghayb' (knowledge of the unseen) granted by Allah, distinguishing them from the general populace. It underscores the dual role of the Messenger as both a conveyer of the divine message (Risalah) and a sincere advisor (Nasihah), establishing the foundation for their authoritative guidance.
